underCanopyVerdict: The added darkness is not materially perceptible and therefore is not a meaningful natural improvement. Visible darkness still comes from hard individual cast shadows and small clump-shaped blotches rather than broad, soft, irregularly modulated floor occlusion.
biggestRemainingGap: The forest still reads as isolated repetitive trees planted over uniform bright turf; the references unify interlocking crowns, understory, leaf-litter floor, and soft irregular darkness into one woodland volume.
smallestNextImprovement: Apply one restrained mottled value reduction only beneath the densest adjoining crowns, feathering irregularly to zero before roads and parcel boundaries. Accept it only if frame 000 loses obvious olive holes while roads remain unchanged and frames 276-279 stay pop-free.
